title: The First Letter Acrostic
description:
An anonymous letter contained the following verse:
**P**lease come at once.
**O**ver the ridge.
**I**n the chapel.
**S**ee the crypt.
**O**btain key.
**N**ow hurry.
question: Extract the secret word formed by the first letter of each line:
acceptable_answer_format:
Type only the hidden word.

Example:
SECRET
hints: Look at the first letter of each line.
solution_explanation: Extracting the first letter of each line (**P**lease, **O**ver, **I**n, **S**ee, **O**btain, **N**ow) spells POISON.
